prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Summon and Control Your Desktop Pet", "Learn how to show, hide, and interact with your new companion anytime on your desktop.", "Press Alt+P to show or hide your pet at any time.", "Try Summoning Pet"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "We are generating animations, sound effects, and desktop behavioral scripts."]
2: ["Name Your New Companion", "Give your desktop pet a unique name for their official adoption records.", "Pet Name", "Confirm Name"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop", "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick interactions, feeding, and settings.", "Start Desktop Experience"]
4: ["Generating custom pet model assets usually takes around 15-30 seconds."]
5: ["We will notify you immediately once your pet is ready to appear on your desktop."]
6: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companions", "Scroll through pet stories to choose who will live on your desktop."]
7: ["Log in with your original account to ensure existing adopted pets and items are restored."]
8: ["Your pet runs in the system tray! Click the tray icon if your pet ever hides."]
9: ["Quick setup takes less than 2 minutes. Pick your path to begin!"]
